en: I had such a great time!

It's been awhile since I had this much fun
doing something other than the piano!
If you want...let's hang out again.
I want to know more about you, Shuichi...
L-Let's walk back to the dorms together!

Well, that was enjoyable! Why do I have
so much fun hanging out with you?

Maybe you know how to make it fun
for other people, Shuichi.
Okay, let's head back to the dorms.
Sorry, but I'm gonna head back now.

If I knew this was gonna happen, I would've
played the piano by myself instead...
